text.en: Most pet owners highlight the team for being compassionate, dependable, and flexible with last-minute schedule changes. Clients with long-term arrangements appreciate consistent caregivers who arrive on time and follow home instructions carefully, though one reviewer noted occasional coverage difficulties during peak booking seasons.

title.en: Caring handling for cats and dogs

text.en: Clients frequently note that their pets receive gentle, attentive care during daytime visits and overnight stays. Owners of older or anxious animals observe that their cats and dogs remain calm and content while their families are away, with several reviewers expressing relief that their pets settled happily without undue stress.

Pet parents appreciate receiving consistent updates and photos from sitters after daily visits, which offers reassurance while travelling. While one client reported difficulty arranging sitter coverage and receiving late cancellation notices, most owners praise the office staff for prompt responses and helpful booking adjustments.

q.en: Does Society Pet Sitter provide overnight care?

a.en: Yes, caregivers offer overnight pet sitting services in the client home alongside daytime drop-in visits.

q.en: Do pet owners receive updates during visits?

a.en: Yes, clients report receiving regular text updates and photographs of their pets during scheduled visits.

q.en: Are the sitters able to accommodate schedule changes?

a.en: Reviewers note that the team often accommodates last-minute requests or adjustments to pet routines when coverage allows.

q.en: What types of animals does the service look after?

a.en: Clients primarily use the service for cats and dogs, including multi-pet households and older animals needing calm care.
